definition: A remote, uninhabited tropical island

definition: Colored or shining like gold
examples: We walked along the beautiful golden beach at sunset.

definition: To give a polite word or sign of welcome or recognition to someone on meeting
examples: She went to the door to greet her arriving guests.

definition: Human beings in general; humanity
examples: The invention of antibiotics was a great leap forward for the human race.

definition: A person or animal that lives in or occupies a place
examples: The city has over a million inhabitants.

definition: To send a missile, spacecraft, or satellite into the air or into space
examples: The agency plans to launch the new satellite into orbit next month.

definition: A person or thing that carries a message or is employed to carry messages

definition: An important assignment carried out for political, religious, or commercial purposes, typically involving travel
examples: The astronauts successfully completed their mission to repair the space telescope.

definition: To be entitled or appointed to act or speak for someone, or to be a symbol of something
examples: She was chosen to represent her school at the national debate.

definition: The collection of eight planets and their moons in orbit around the sun
examples: Earth is the third planet from the sun in our solar system.

definition: The investigation of physical conditions in space and on stars, planets, and their moons
examples: Space exploration has led to numerous technological advancements.

definition: A vehicle used for traveling in space
examples: The unmanned spacecraft landed safely on the surface of Mars.

definition: To cause something to pass on from one place or person to another; to broadcast a signal
examples: The satellite can transmit data back to Earth in a matter of seconds.

definition: A very large marine mammal with a streamlined hairless body
examples: We took a boat tour hoping to see a blue whale in the ocean.

definition: An arrangement made with a bank whereby one may deposit and withdraw money
examples: I need to transfer some money into my bank account to pay the bills.

definition: To communicate with someone, typically in order to give or receive specific information
examples: Please contact me as soon as you have an update on the project.

definition: A handle on a door that is turned to release the latch
examples: He turned the brass doorknob and pushed the door open.

definition: A mechanism for maintaining temperatures at an acceptable level in a building

definition: The branch of technology that deals with dimensions and tolerances of less than 100 nanometers
examples: Nanotechnology is being used to create new types of medical treatments.

definition: To use up the available supply of something
examples: We need to stop at the gas station before we run out of fuel.

definition: To make a thorough or dramatic change in the form, appearance, or character of

definition: To contain as much or as many as is possible or normal; to have eaten enough

definition: A thing given willingly to someone without payment; a present
examples: He bought her a beautiful necklace as a birthday gift.

definition: Polite or well-bred social behavior

definition: A person who receives or entertains other people as guests
examples: Our host greeted us warmly and offered us something to drink.

definition: A dough of flour, fat, and water, used as a base and covering in baked dishes such as pies
examples: We stopped at the bakery to buy coffee and a sweet pastry.

definition: At a recent time; not long ago

definition: Morally good, justified, or acceptable; true or correct as a fact

definition: Offensively impolite or ill-mannered

definition: A scenario or gathering where people interact with one another
examples: He often feels anxious and shy when he is in a new social situation.

definition: A small shaped piece of sweet food made with sugar

definition: People who are ill or unwell, considered as a group

definition: A marriage ceremony, especially considered as including the associated celebrations

definition: An improved level of wealth, comfort, material goods, and necessities available
examples: The new economic policies resulted in a better standard of living for the middle class.

definition: Done or made manually rather than by a machine
examples: These traditional carpets are still carefully woven by hand.

definition: A combustible black or dark brown rock consisting mainly of carbonized plant matter, found mainly in underground deposits and widely used as fuel
examples: Many old trains were powered by burning coal.

definition: The business and process of extracting coal from the ground

definition: A building or group of buildings where goods are manufactured or assembled chiefly by machine
examples: He works on the assembly line in a large automobile factory.

definition: Houses and apartments considered collectively

definition: To make or become better

definition: Relating to or characterized by industry

definition: The process of weaving or producing fabric

definition: An excavation in the earth for extracting coal or other minerals

definition: Filled with too many people or things

definition: To supply a device with mechanical or electrical energy

definition: To open out so as to extend over a large area, or to reach more people
examples: The news about the festival spread quickly through the town.

definition: The vapor into which water is converted when heated, forming a white mist in the air
examples: The engine was driven by the high pressure of boiling steam.

definition: A long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving
examples: She used a needle and some black thread to fix the button on her coat.

definition: To form into a bent, curling, or distorted shape; to combine strands into a thread
examples: You have to twist the wires together to make a secure connection.

definition: A fixed regular payment, typically paid on a daily or weekly basis, made by an employer to an employee

definition: The environment and circumstances in which an employee works
examples: The union is fighting to improve working conditions and safety in the warehouse.

definition: To talk in a friendly and informal way
examples: We stayed up late to chat about our upcoming vacation.

definition: To inflict physical harm on something so as to impair its value, usefulness, or normal function

definition: To prevent someone from giving full attention to something

definition: Causing or likely to cause harm or injury

definition: To fail to care for properly

definition: The flat panel on an electronic device where images and text are displayed
examples: Looking at a bright screen in a dark room can strain your eyes.

definition: In a way that shows wisdom or good sense
examples: She decided to spend her money sensibly and save a portion of it.

definition: A device or implement, especially one held in the hand, used to carry out a particular function
examples: A hammer is an essential tool for carpentry.

definition: A matter dealt with in a text, discourse, or conversation
examples: Climate change was the main topic of discussion at the global conference.
